items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: So, I never, my daddy taught me, don't try to imitate anybody else on your instrument.

ctx.x: What was his name? Trumpet. Trumpet. Mm-hmm.

Yeah, a little carnet he was playing and he doubted himself, you know. And, I told him, forget about it. Don't doubt you, he said, just go right along and, like for me, I don't care what banjo player they have out there, I'm going to do what I know how to do. Somebody's going to like my playing. So, forget about the next guy. Finally, you may be getting, you may get to be greater, as great, or greater than he.
